payout_quote: To qualify for the $300 incentive, the business must open a business checking account ... make deposits totaling at least $5,000 in a calendar month for two of the first six months of account opening; and complete five transactions (deposits, withdrawals, etc.) within the first 60 days.
biggest_catch: Requires moving real business volume through the account — deposits totaling at least $5,000 in a calendar month for two of the first six months plus five transactions in the first 60 days; no shortcut.
catches: MIDFLORIDA Credit Union eligibility and membership requirements for the business and business owner(s) apply — primarily serves Florida.
Excludes Freedom Business Checking; Business Checking Plus Interest limited to 2 accounts per TIN/SSN.
Any business EIN that has previously received a business checking incentive does not qualify.
Account must remain open and unrestricted until the incentive is paid.
$300 is reported to the IRS; recipient responsible for taxes.
Offer valid as of September 1, 2026 and may be canceled at any time without notice.
No dividends are paid on Free Business Checking and Premier Business Checking.
Minimum to open: $100 (Free Business Checking), $500 (Premier / Plus Interest).
eligibility: Businesses eligible for MIDFLORIDA Credit Union membership (Florida footprint) opening a new eligible business checking account, whose EIN has not previously received a business checking incentive.
numeric_basis: payout from official MIDFLORIDA terms ($300 flat); time: account opening, enrollment, and deposit/transaction activity, est. 60-120 min active
timing: Open eligible account; $5,000+ deposits in a calendar month for two of the first six months; 5 transactions within first 60 days; $300 deposited within 14 days after qualifications are met.
steps: Open an eligible MIDFLORIDA business checking account (Free Business Checking min $100 / Premier min $500 / Plus Interest min $500; excludes Freedom Business Checking).
Accept and enroll in Online Banking and eStatement.
Make deposits totaling at least $5,000 in a calendar month for two of the first six months after opening.
Complete five transactions (deposits, withdrawals, etc.) within the first 60 days.
Receive the $300 incentive deposited to the new business checking account within 14 days after qualifications are met.
